decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly pressure the opponent. Cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls provide early threats, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory help buff your team and finish off the opponent. Goblin Bombardment and Quantum Riddler offer additional ways to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's three-color identity, ensuring smooth and consistent plays throughout the game.

This deck is focused on quickly and aggressively getting Hollow One onto the battlefield by utilizing cards that allow for discarding and drawing multiple cards at once. By using cards like Faithless Looting and Burning Inquiry, the deck aims to fill up the graveyard with creatures like Vengevine and bring them back into play for a powerful assault. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Marauding Mako to keep the opponent's board clear while building up its own aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells and hand disruption, while also utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Necrodominance and Dauthi Voidwalker. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and March of Wretched Sorrow provide additional control elements, while Orcish Bowmasters and Boggart Trawler help maintain board presence. The deck also includes a finisher in Soul Spike, allowing the player to drain their opponent's life total for the win. Overall, the strategy revolves around outvaluing and outlasting the opponent through a combination of control and resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost spells and creatures, while also utilizing card draw and manipulation to maintain a consistent tempo. The deck focuses on early aggression with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to filter through the deck and find key pieces, while also enabling additional damage. The deck aims to win through efficient use of resources and overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to use Broodscale Bloodchief and other support cards to create a powerful combo that overwhelms the opponent. By utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Malevolent Rumble, and Sowing Mycospawn, the deck can quickly build up a threatening board presence. The inclusion of cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Urza's Saga provide additional win conditions and ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to establish a dominating position on the battlefield and close out the game with its powerful combo pieces.

The deck focuses on quickly getting Cosmogoyf onto the battlefield using cards like Devourer of Destiny and Plunge into Darkness. It also includes powerful combo pieces like Thud and Chancellor of the Dross to deal damage to the opponent. With the ability to search for key cards using cards like Spoils of the Vault and Summoner's Pact, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, game-winning play. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of disruption and protection cards to control the game and ensure its combo can go off smoothly.

This deck focuses on playing cheap artifacts to enable aggressive plays, while also using synergies with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats like Cori-Steel Cutter and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. It also incorporates interaction and disruption with cards like Unholy Heat and Metallic Rebuke to control the battlefield and protect its own threats. This deck is all about speed, efficiency, and resource management to win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating big creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. It also utilizes cards like Psychic Frog and Fallaji Archaeologist to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck aims to combo off and win the game in a single turn by bringing back powerful threats from the graveyard. It includes cards for card draw, interaction, and protection to ensure the combo can be executed successfully. The strategy is to surprise the opponent with unexpected plays and overwhelm them with powerful creatures.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures to limit the opponent's options and maintain card advantage. Quantum Riddler and Psychic Frog provide card advantage and disruption, while Orcish Bowmasters and Subtlety help control the opponent's board. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student offers card selection and recursive card advantage. The deck also includes finishers like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while advancing its own game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of various cards to quickly bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard into play. By using cards like Faithless Looting, Persist, Unearth, and Thoughtseize to fill the graveyard and manipulate the top of the library, the deck can efficiently reanimate creatures such as Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Fatal Push to control the game and protect the combo. The aim is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures early in the game.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy through a combination of counter spells, hand disruption, and removal spells. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by constantly disrupting their game plan while also generating card advantage through card draw and recursion effects. By using a combination of efficient removal spells and disruptive creatures, the deck is able to control the board and prevent the opponent from executing their own game plan effectively.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays utilizing low-cost creatures and pump spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells and disruptive cards to control the board and maintain pressure. The strategy revolves around efficiently using mana and sequencing plays to maximize damage output and maintain board presence. Key cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Guide of Souls, and Voice of Victory are essential in executing this fast-paced game plan. The deck aims to finish the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and blinking effects to control the board and generate value. By flickering creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Quantum Riddler, the deck can repeatedly trigger powerful effects and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Fatal Push and Thoughtseize provide additional interaction and disruption, while Solitude and Prismatic Ending offer removal options. With a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile game plan that can adapt to a variety of situations.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones using cards like Faithless Looting and Thought Scour, then bringing them back to the battlefield with Unearth and Persist. This combination creates a deadly reanimation engine that can overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's hand, allowing the reanimator combo to go off smoothly.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a variety of cards to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also controlling the board with removal spells and disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. The deck focuses on creating fast and unexpected combinations using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate, allowing for explosive plays that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Psychic Frog and Quantum Riddler provide additional value and card advantage, making the deck versatile and adaptable to different situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier back from the graveyard. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Solitude to control the board and protect your combo pieces. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, with the ability to win games quickly if left unchecked.
